name: loom
description: ClickHouse Loom: shared long-term memory and code intelligence for AI coding agents, self-hosted.

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: Shared long-term memory and code intelligence for Claude Code: MCP tools to save and recall decisions across sessions, hooks that capture each session with no model call, and a code index that answers structure questions without whole-file reads.
